question: Describe the two pinned CPU backends on this Mac during one declared work period.
prior_information: Record any earlier setup, quality and timing results seen before freezing this method.

host_condition.machine: Record the target Mac and memory capacity.
host_condition.background: Declare which services remain running. Stop other model, build, test and benchmark jobs.
required_before_launch: fixed power mode and host identity
unchanged thermal availability and reported limits
host_condition.service_changes: Record the prior state of any temporarily stopped service; restore and verify it after the study.

setup.eligibility: Valid native output, resources, unchanged inputs, valid timing guard and no effective host stop.
setup.failure: Retain the attempt and stop. No retry, replacement or partial calibration.
setup.measured_deadline_rule: max(600, ceil(2 * longest eligible continuous seconds / 60) * 60)

measurement.assignment: Balanced adjacent CPU/KleidiAI pairs with shuffled workload order.
measurement.session_spacing: Consecutive blocks within one work period, not independent replications.
measurement.native_settings: The pinned benchmark.py settings, with upstream warmup enabled.

host_rule.swap_activity: Record all increases without filtering or timing adjustment.
host_rule.other_departure: Stop new launches on missing/reset counters or changed AC, mode, pressure, thermal or identity readings. Preserve completed observations with flags.
host_rule.timing: Require the pinned benchmark_timing.py policy and its continuous/awake clock checks. Retain timing-invalid observations without performance claims.

analysis.ratio: CPU mean duration divided by KleidiAI mean duration for each complete valid pair.
analysis.report: All 48 planned outcomes, raw repetitions, pair ratios, session median/range and host findings.
analysis.limits: Descriptive observations on one Mac. No significance, tail-latency or universal speedup claim. Synthetic compute excludes complete Q&A and model loading. Quality and backend adoption require separate review.
